name: WARDOGS
author: support@shadowhavenhosting.net
description: WARDOGS (Bulkhead / Team17) Unreal Engine 5 dedicated server. Installs from the Steam community-provider branch with a licensed Steam account, renders Configs/ServerSettings.ini from the Startup variables, and auto-updates in place. Requires enrolment in Bulkhead's approved community-provider program for the Steam licence, App ID and Pragma PatchId.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# WARDOGS dedicated server - Pterodactyl/Pelican install script (Shadow Haven Hosting)
# Runs in the installer container; /mnt/server becomes /home/container.
apt-get update >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates tar lib32gcc-s1 lib32stdc++6 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/Configs /mnt/server/Saved/Logs /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
if [ ! -f steamcmd.sh ]; then
  echo "[Install] Downloading SteamCMD.."
  curl -sSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz
fi

if [ -z "${SRCDS_APPID}" ]; then
  echo "[Install] SRCDS_APPID is empty. Set it to the WARDOGS dedicated-server App ID from Bulkhead's community-provider program, then reinstall."
  echo "[Install] Continuing so the server skeleton exists; the boot script will refuse to start until the game is installed."
else
  if [ -n "${STEAM_USER}" ]; then
    LOGIN="+login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH}"
  else
    echo "[Install] WARNING: no STEAM_USER set. The '${SRCDS_BETAID}' branch is only licensed to approved providers; anonymous will fail."
    LOGIN="+login anonymous"
  fi
  BETA=""
  [ -n "${SRCDS_BETAID}" ]   && BETA="${BETA} -beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}"
  [ -n "${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ] && BETA="${BETA} -betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}"
  echo "[Install] Installing app ${SRCDS_APPID} (branch ${SRCDS_BETAID:-public}).."
  ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server ${LOGIN} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} ${BETA} validate +quit
  echo "${SRCDS_BETAID}" > /mnt/server/.install-branch.txt
fi

# Steam client shims the UE Steam subsystem dlopen()s at boot
ln -sf /home/container/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so
ln -sf /home/container/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

# Default config files (the boot script fills in name/password/players/RCON from the panel)
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/Configs/APIWhitelist.txt ]; then
cat > /mnt/server/Configs/APIWhitelist.txt <<'EOF'
# WARDOGS Remote API IP whitelist
# One IP address or CIDR range per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Leave empty to allow any IP.
EOF
fi
chmod -R u+rwX /mnt/server
echo "[Install] Done."

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name of your server as it appears in the Server List.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: If set, this password is required to connect to the server.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum players that can connect at one time (WARDOGS supports 60-100).

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: 0 = never, 1 = check on startup only, 2 = on startup + hourly (server warns, then restarts itself).

variables.name: Auto Update Restart Timer
variables.description: Minutes to wait before restarting for an update when Auto Update is 2.

variables.name: RCON Accessibility
variables.description: 1 = RCON listens on the RCON Port allocation for rcon.wardogs.com / external tools. 0 = 127.0.0.1 only.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for the WARDOGS RCON service. Leave empty to generate one per boot (printed in console and Saved/RCON/ADMIN-PASSWORD.txt).

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: Port RCON listens on when RCON Accessibility is Remote. Must be an allocation assigned to this server (convention: game port + 1).

variables.name: Recycle Hours
variables.description: Graceful cleanup restart after this many hours of uptime. 0 disables.

variables.name: Server Binary
variables.description: File name of the Linux server executable inside Wardogs/Binaries/Linux/ (from the community-provider package).

variables.name: Pragma Branch
variables.description: Backend branch Bulkhead issued to you; becomes -PatchId=<PRAGMA_BRANCH>_COMMUNITY_<HOST_TAG>.

variables.name: Host Tag
variables.description: Your provider tag in the PatchId suffix (Bisect's is BISECT).

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: WARDOGS dedicated-server App ID from the community-provider program.

variables.name: Steam Branch
variables.description: Steam beta branch for the server package.

variables.name: Steam Branch Password
variables.description: Beta branch password, if Bulkhead issued one.

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Steam account holding the community-provider licence (NOT anonymous).

variables.name: Steam Password
variables.description: Password for that Steam account. Use an account with Steam Guard disabled or supply STEAM_AUTH.

variables.name: Steam Guard Code
variables.description: One-time Steam Guard code if the account needs one (usually blank).
